why: Philipp: no automatic ticks; waking the operator (K3.1, tmux 'kimi') on urgent news is still fine and beneficial. Otherwise the operator is prompted on demand.
scope: Gate: scripts/autoprompt_policy.py, called by scripts/daily_checkin.sh and scripts/inject_prompt.sh. scheduled_tick = daily_checkin.sh run by cron or by hand with any reason other than the two daemon review requests. event_wake = daily_checkin.sh 'NEWS REVIEW REQUEST:' (news_watcher) or 'REVALIDATION REQUEST FROM OPPORTUNITY WATCH:' (opportunity_watch). self_followup = operator_followup.sh timers. goal_set = goal_inject.sh set ('/goal clear' always passes). resting_watch CRITICAL wakes and telegram_listener (Philipp's messages) queue directly and are not gated. The 3-hourly crontab line is also commented out.
re_enable: Set scheduled_ticks true and uncomment the daily_checkin line from ~polyclaude/.polyclaude/crontab_backups/crontab.20261102T1239Z.bak.
